imageQa.note: Intentional image-free layouts; no new or changed editorial, affiliate or product imagery. Commercial recommendations use accurate category text links only.

searchConsole.signal: Eight homepage impressions, zero clicks, average position 3.125 and no query rows
searchConsole.decision: The queryless sample is too small to support a Data-led page. The batch follows verified evergreen reader needs while strengthening crawl paths through established tailoring, kitchen-safety and job-transition guides.
searchConsole.ignored: Homepage-only impressions, one aggregate average position and the absence of query rows were not treated as a topical mandate or sufficient evidence for a keyword variation.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed, sponsored/nofollow text recommendations appear only on the food-thermometer guide: instant-read, leave-in probe and oven-safe dial categories. The suit and rollover pages remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-worthy retirement-rollover decision record covering four destination choices, eligibility, tax character, direct-rollover controls, fee and investment comparisons, plan-loan complications, confirmation and tax-file closeout.
authority.cluster: Job-transition and household-finance systems, with reciprocal links from the job-offer, resignation and emergency-fund guides; food-safety and tailoring clusters also gain reciprocal contextual paths.
authority.opportunity: U.S. Department of Labor EBSA and FINRA Investor Education Foundation accuracy-and-education opportunities logged; no outreach sent.

diversity: The portfolio answers three unrelated questions in two departments: whether a suit is a sensible alteration candidate, which thermometer fits a cooking method, and how to compare and document a retirement rollover. The high-intent thermometer guide is commercial, the rollover record expands financial authority, and the alteration guide explores a distinct service decision; none is driven by the weak Search Console sample.
